scope.start: before child launch; first child tree sample while exec gate remains closed
scope.end: command exit plus configured post-cleanup interval; known surviving descendants remain sampled
scope.rss: sum duplicates shared pages; sampled peaks can miss spikes
scope.pss: best effort /proc smaps_rollup; null and completeness flags mark inaccessible scopes; excludes unmapped file cache
scope.roles: heuristics only; a DedicatedWorker/WASM/ORT allocator cannot be separated from its Chromium renderer process here
scope.sharedCgroup: shared with all workloads; memory.peak is historical; memory.stat file already includes shmem, so do not add them
scope.tmpFilesystem: shared /tmp filesystem occupancy, not private tensor bytes or command-owned memory
notObserved: memory after retained surviving descendants stop being observed
